title: Great quality, amazing cup!
text: Great quality, amazing cup!. I am very pleased and impressed with my MalloMe purchase.  So much so that I bought a second one for my son.  It is great, it keeps ice all day at least 12+ hours.  So far I am drinking more water because it keeps it so cold & refreshing.  The first day my son used his MalloMe cup he came home from work and was raving about how great the cup was at keeping his drink cold.  You have got to get one of these if you are considering this cup.  Go for it, you won't' be disappointed!

product_metadata.title: MalloMe BEARCLAW Insulated Tumbler With Handle & Straw - Stainless Steel Tumblers Coffee Travel Mug - Reusable Insulated Cup for Water with Brush, 2 Lids & Straws - Splash-Proof 30 Oz Aquamarine Blue
features: ✅ SCREW TIGHT LEAK PROOF LIDS x 2 - Say goodbye to spills and leaky pushdown lids. Our over-engineered thread design and rubber gasket produces a superior seal. Simply screw it down for a stress-free drink on the go.

✅ KEEPS ICE OVER 24 HOURS / HOT DRINKS 6+ HOURS – Our vacuum insulated tumbler never sweats and maximizes temperature retention. Each set Includes a tumbler, reusable stainless steel straw, handle, 2x leak proof lids and straw cleaning brush.

✅ BUILT TO LAST - Colder than a yeti, strong as a beast. Go tell your friend Stanley these 20Oz and 30Oz Bearclaw tumblers are legit. Solid 18/8 stainless steel cup construction inside and out, rust proof, easy to clean, beautiful but tough as nails.

✅ GREAT FOR TRAVEL - Narrow, tall design fits more cup holders and makes life that much easier. Excellent as a coffee tumbler or travel mug for work, college or the office. Enjoy your fresh hot morning coffee in this gorgeous flask until lunch time.

✅ PERFECT GIFT for men, women, family and friends for any occasion. Available as a 20 oz or 30 oz tumbler with handle, finished in brilliant stainless steel or in your choice of refreshing colors with more pop than an ice-cold soft drink.
description: Good-bye room temperature liquids. Introducing the MalloMe BEARCLAW 30oz and 20oz vacuum insulated tumbler range. Vacuum Insulation Technology This tumbler has a double walled exterior with a vacuum between the walls. This means that there are no air molecules between your drink and the exterior. The transfer of heat or cold from your beverage to the outside world is virtually eliminated. Your drink will truly stay as hot or cold as science allows. Even filled with ice or boiling water, the bottle will never sweat or get hot to the touch! Premium 18/8 Stainless Steel The MalloMe insulated tumblers are made of high quality food grade 18/8 stainless steel. Whether you are drinking water or coffee, this tumbler will not retain the taste or smell of any liquid. Sliding & Splash Proof Drinking Lids are included. A sleek and durable lid is included for easy drinking and to keep your drink insulated! Free handle & straw for sipping and handle for gripping, the MalloMe Bearclaw tumbler makes for the perfect travel companion. Perfect for any event or adventure. This tumbler is perfect at keeping you hydrated at the office, while camping, on road trips, hiking, cycling, golfing, shopping and so much more! Use as a travel mug, coffee cup, tea cup and water bottle.
